F1-score = 2 * (Precision * Recall) / (Precision + Recall)

Recall = TP / (TP + FN) = 10 / (10 + 7) = 10 / 17 ≈ 0.59

Now, calculate F1-score:
F1-score = 2 * (Precision * Recall) / (Precision + Recall)
